test.fill_query: INSERT INTO promql_old_window_ts (metric_name, tags, samples) SELECT 'old_window_metric', map('instance', toString(number), 'job', toString(number % 4)), arrayMap(step -> (toDateTime64(1000000 + step * 15, 3), round(1e9 + step * 1500 + (sipHash64(number, step) % 100) / 100, 2)), range(40320)) FROM numbers_mt(2000)
test.query: SELECT * FROM prometheusQueryRange('promql_old_window_ts', 'rate(old_window_metric[5m])', 1302400, 1306000, 60) SETTINGS max_threads = 4 FORMAT Null
SELECT * FROM prometheusQuery('promql_old_window_ts', 'sum(count_over_time(old_window_metric[6h]))', 1306000) SETTINGS max_threads = 4 FORMAT Null
SELECT * FROM prometheusQueryRange('promql_old_window_ts', 'sum by (job) (rate(old_window_metric[5m]))', 1000000, 1604800, 900) SETTINGS max_threads = 4 FORMAT Null
